summary: Coach Dashboard V2 Iteration 3 backend testing complete. All 26 pytest cases PASSED (100% success). Covered Priority 4 (Draft-vs-Live diff + Publish) and Priority 5 (Inline Workout Editor: meta patch, exercise patch/delete/add/reorder). Verified delta_kind classification (unchanged/modified/added/live_only), delta_bullets human strings, publish version bumping + snapshot + accepted/rejected change_set flow, DecisionRecord writes (layer=PUBLISH scope_kind=plan_version, and layer=HOW scope_kind=workout_implementation), draft status transitions (partially_approved/promoted), programme.live_plan_version bump, coach role gate (403 for non-coach), V2 flag gate (409 on both diff+publish), 404 for nonexistent draft/impl, 409 for already-promoted draft, 409 for live-only impl edit attempts, 400 for invalid month/index/non-permutation reorder, and idempotency of re-publishing. Guardrail: no AI/bot wording found in any response body. No issues detected.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_v2_coach_publish.plan_publish: In the 'selected' scope path, when assignment_ids is provided but a targeted assignment has NO draft_implementation_id, it is silently skipped without any signal in the response. Consider returning a 'skipped_count' or 'skipped_ids' so the coach UI can distinguish 'nothing to promote' from 'silently ignored'.

feature_v2_coach_publish.plan_publish: The 'idempotent re-publish' branch (line 380-383) still counts the assignment in promoted_ids AND still creates a NEW plan_version + snapshot even if 0 actual DB writes happened. This is technically not double-promoting (data unchanged), but it inflates version numbers on every retry click. Consider short-circuiting to return the previous version if promoted_ids only contains already-live assignments AND accepted_ids is empty.

feature_v2_coach_inline_editor.impl_patch_meta: The 'no-op' short-circuit compares len(upd) == 3 to detect that only timestamps were set. This is fragile — if the meta model gains one more auto-populated field, the constant 3 becomes wrong. Prefer tracking a boolean 'had_real_change' flag as you populate upd.
seed_data_creation: Inserted (and cleaned up) TEST_iter3_-prefixed programme, draft, plan_version v1, 5 workout_implementations, 4 workout_assignments covering all delta_kinds (modified/added/live_only/unchanged), 2 proposed change_sets, and 4 training_objectives. All docs deleted at session teardown; DB verified clean post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_v2_coach_publish_and_editor.py can be re-run after any change to feature_v2_coach_publish.py or feature_v2_coach_inline_editor.py — it fully seeds and tears down its own data using the CLIENT_ID d6e0be44-d3a5-407f-bc04-7cc7ef96179a. Louis is used as the coach; reviewer@crewfit.net is used to prove the coach-role gate (returns 403). One item worth eyes on next iteration: the 'idempotent re-publish' behaviour (see critical_code_review_comments) — current implementation still bumps plan_version even when nothing effectively changed; if you want strict idempotency, add a guard.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All specified acceptance criteria met.
